_note: 通いの人妻家政婦。28歳・既婚（夫は単身赴任で不在がち）の家政婦が、一人暮らしの依頼主（20代の成人男性）の部屋で『これもサービスのうちですから』と言いながら世話を焼きすぎていく30日。指輪はつけたまま距離だけが近くなる。ヒロインが面倒見よく押しが強い側、相手役は甘えてしまう側。導入は非性的。登場人物は全員成人。

poses: wide shot of an apartment entrance in daytime, she stands in the doorway with a cleaning caddy at her feet, full body, bowing slightly toward viewer,
close up of her left hand holding out a contract sheet and a pen toward viewer, wedding ring clearly visible on her finger,
from above, looking down at her at the shoe step as she lines up her own shoes neatly, dutch angle,
waist up from the side, she looks around the cluttered entrance hall, eyebrows slightly raised,
lines: 今日から　お願いします
lines2: 結婚してますけど、　気に　しないで　くださいね

poses: wide shot of the apartment kitchen, she scrubs the stainless sink with both hands, sleeves rolled up, full body from the front,
close up of her wet hands wringing a cloth over the sink, wedding ring wet with water droplets,
from above, overhead view of the sink and her bent back as she works, high angle,
waist up from the side, she turns her face toward viewer mid work, a strand of hair stuck to her cheek,
lines: 排水口、　開けますね
そこまで　頼んでない　です
lines2: これも　サービスの　うちですから

poses: wide shot, she stands in front of an open refrigerator, its light on her face, full body, kitchen in the evening,
close up of her fingers turning a container to read the date on the lid, ring on her left hand,
from below, low angle looking up as she reaches to the top shelf, arm raised,
medium shot from behind her shoulder, viewer sees the sorted shelves she has made, she glances back,
lines: 中身、　全部　見ました
勝手に　開けたん　ですか
lines2: うちの　人にも　同じこと　してます
……旦那さん、　大変　ですね

poses: wide shot of the dining table covered with storage containers, she stands behind them presenting them with one hand, full body,
close up of a spoon held out toward viewer, steam rising, her ringed hand cupped underneath it,
from above, top down view of the lined up containers and her hands writing labels,
waist up from a low three quarter angle, she watches viewer taste it, head slightly tilted,
lines: 五日ぶん　作りました
lines2: 夫が　単身赴任で、　作りがいが　なくて
……それで　こっちに　来るのか

poses: wide shot at the apartment hallway in the morning, she stands beside four sorted garbage bags, full body,
close up of her hand tapping a hand written collection schedule taped to the wall, ring catching the light,
from above, high angle on the bags and her feet, she points down with her toe,
medium shot from the side, she holds a bag out toward viewer who is half ready for work,
lines2: だから　溜まるんです

poses: wide shot of a small laundry corner, she crouches in front of the washing machine, full body, from the front,
close up of her finger pressing the machine buttons, detergent cap in her other hand,
from behind at a low angle, the open drum and her back as she loads it,
waist up from the side, she stands and turns to viewer holding a folded towel against her chest,
lines: 洗剤、　量　間違ってます
適当に　入れてました
lines2: 指輪が　傷むので　手袋　しますね

poses: wide shot of the dining table, she sits with receipts spread out and a grocery bag beside her, full body,
close up of her hand smoothing a receipt flat on the table, pen resting between her ringed fingers,
from above, top down on the spread of receipts and her two hands sorting them,
medium shot from the opposite seat, she looks up at viewer over the paperwork, chin lowered,
lines: 買い出しの　分、　ここに
細かく　つけるん　ですね
lines2: 家計簿　歴　十年です
……勝てる　気が　しない

poses: wide shot of open kitchen cupboards, plates stacked on the floor around her, she kneels in the middle, full body,
close up of her hands stacking bowls, wedding ring against the white china,
from a low angle, she stretches up to the highest shelf, apron hem swaying,
medium shot from the doorway, viewer watches from a distance while she gestures at the rearranged shelf,
lines: 高さ、　入れ替えました
どこに　何が　あるか　わからない
lines2: 覚えなくて　いいです。　わたしが　います
……それは　そう　だけど

poses: wide shot at the apartment door, she holds out her open palm toward viewer, full body, evening light in the hallway,
extreme close up of a spare key dropped into her ringed palm, both hands in frame,
from above, overhead view of the two of them at the threshold, her hand closing around the key,
waist up from the side, she slips the key into her apron pocket, eyes lowered, small smile,
lines: 鍵、　お預かり　します
留守でも　入るって　ことですか
lines2: そのほうが　効率が　いいので

poses: wide shot of a spotless living room at night, she is still there wiping the table while viewer stands in the entrance with a bag, full body,
close up of a note left on the table in neat handwriting, her ringed fingertip resting on it,
from above, high angle of the tidy room, she looks up toward the camera,
medium shot from the side, she puts on her coat by the door while talking, half turned to viewer,
lines: まだ　いたんですか
lines2: 言ってみたかった　だけ　です

poses: wide shot of a bookshelf with its contents on the floor, she sits cross legged sorting them, full body,
close up of her hands lifting a small box, ringed fingers resting on the lid,
from a high angle behind her, viewer looks down at the sorted piles she made,
medium shot, she holds the box up toward viewer and looks straight at him, one eyebrow raised,
lines: これ、　どこに　しまいます？
それは　見なくて　いいやつ　です
lines2: うちの人の　も　似たような　場所に　ありました

poses: wide shot of an open closet in the bedroom, shirts on hangers, she stands framed inside it, full body,
close up of her hand running along the shoulders of the hanging shirts, ring sliding over the fabric,
from below, low angle as she reaches for the upper rail, sleeve sliding down her forearm,
medium shot from the bedroom doorway, viewer sees her back and her glance over the shoulder,
lines: 夏物、　しまいますね
寝室は　いいですって
lines2: 服は　わたしの　範囲です
……そういう　線引き　なんだ

poses: wide shot of the bedroom, she snaps a fresh sheet open over the bed, fabric floating mid air, full body,
close up of her hands tucking the sheet corner under the mattress, knuckles and ring pressed down,
from above, top down of the made bed and her leaning across it,
waist up from the side, she straightens up and presses a hand to her lower back, breathing out,
lines: 週に　一度は　替えます
自分で　やりますって
lines2: 甘えて　いいんですよ

poses: wide shot of the living room floor covered with folded laundry, she kneels in the middle of it, full body,
close up of her hands folding fabric into a precise square, wrists together, ring in frame,
from a high angle, overhead of the laundry basket and the neat stacks beside it,
medium shot, she holds up a worn out shirt toward viewer with two fingers, unimpressed look,
lines: これ、　いつから　使ってます？
……そこまで　見るん　ですね
lines2: 見ますよ。　仕事　ですから
仕事の　顔　じゃ　ない　です　よね

poses: wide shot of the living room in daytime, she stands facing viewer with a tape measure held between her hands, full body,
extreme close up of the tape measure numbers and her ringed fingertip pinning a spot on it,
from the side at chest height, she leans in close to read the measurement, hair bun in profile,
medium shot from a low angle, she writes the number into a small notebook, glancing down at viewer,
lines: 腕の　長さ、　測ります
なんの　ため　ですか
lines2: シャツ、　買っておきます　ね
そこまで　頼んで　ない　です

poses: wide shot of the dining table at dusk, she sits writing a report while viewer stands behind her chair, full body,
close up of the report sheet dense with small handwriting, her pen still moving, ring visible,
from above at a dutch angle, top down on the page and her hand,
medium shot from the seat across the table, she slides the sheet toward viewer and folds her hands,
lines2: やることが　増えたので
増やした　覚えは　ない　です

poses: wide shot of the living room in the evening, she sits on the floor beside a low table, her coat still on the hook, full body,
close up of a wall clock past the end of her shift, her hand not reaching for it,
from a high angle behind her, the quiet room and her back, lamp on,
medium shot from the side, she looks up at viewer standing over her, unbothered,
lines: 時間、　過ぎてますよ
帰らないん　ですか
lines2: 帰っても　誰も　いないので

poses: wide shot of the dining table set for two, she pulls out the second chair, full body, warm light,
close up of two bowls set side by side, her ringed hand placing the chopsticks,
from above, top down of the table and both of their hands reaching in,
waist up from the side, she eats quietly, cheek slightly full, eyes toward viewer,
lines: 二人ぶん　作りました
それも　範囲内　ですか
lines2: ひとりで　食べるの、　飽きました

poses: wide shot of the apartment hallway at night, light leaking from the door she left open, she stands in it, full body,
close up of her hand on the door frame, keys hanging from one ringed finger,
from a low angle looking up at her in the lit doorway, viewer arriving out of the dark hallway,
medium shot from behind the viewer's shoulder, she steps aside to let him in, chin tipped toward the room,
lines: なんで　まだ　いるん　ですか
lines2: 顔　見てから　帰ろうと　思って

poses: wide shot at the entrance, she holds up two identical keys between her fingers, full body,
extreme close up of the two keys side by side in her palm, ring right beside them,
from above, high angle of her hand dropping one key back into her apron pocket,
medium shot from the side, she watches the viewer's reaction, head slightly tilted, faint smile,
lines: 相談　なしに　ですか
lines2: なくすと　困るのは　そちらです
……断る　タイミング、　逃した

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), tired but gentle expression,
poses: wide shot of the kitchen after work, she pulls the apron strings loose behind her back, full body, evening light,
close up of her ringed fingers at the knot, the apron slipping from her waist,
from a low angle, she drapes the folded apron over the chair back, arm extended,
medium shot from the side, she rolls her shoulders and lets out a breath, glancing at viewer,
lines: 今日は　ここまでに　します
lines2: 少し　座っても　いいですか
どうぞ、　自分の　家みたいに

poses: wide shot of a small bathroom, she crouches scrubbing the tub, sleeves pushed up high, full body,
close up of her forearm and wet hands on the tub edge, ring and running water,
from above, high angle down into the bathroom, her back and the shower head,
waist up from the doorway, she looks back at viewer, damp hair at her temple,
lines: ここ、　一番　手を　抜いてましたね
見ないで　ください　よ
lines2: ……もう　なにも　言えない

poses: wide shot of the kitchen, she holds her soaked sleeve away from her arm, full body,
close up of the wet cuff being wrung out over the sink, droplets falling from her ring,
from a low three quarter angle, she unbuttons the cuff and pushes the sleeve to her elbow,
medium shot, a dry towel is held out to her and she reaches for it, eyes meeting viewer,
lines: タオル、　使って　ください
lines2: 指輪まで　びしょびしょ　です

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), embarrassed but composed expression,
poses: wide shot of the bedroom, she stands in a borrowed oversized shirt with the sleeves rolled twice, full body,
close up of her hand pinching the too long hem, ringed fingers folding it over,
from a high angle, she sits on the edge of the bed looking down at herself,
medium shot from the side, she turns to viewer with both arms held slightly out,
lines: 少し　お借りします
lines2: 洗って　返します。　当然
自分の　シャツ　なんです　けど

poses: wide shot of the bedroom at night, she sits on the floor with her back against the bed, full body, lamp light,
close up of her hand around a warm mug, thumb on the rim, ring against the ceramic,
from above, high angle looking down at her sitting with her knees drawn up,
medium shot from the side, she rests her chin on her knee and looks toward viewer,
lines: もう　仕事着じゃ　ないので
lines2: 困っては　ない　です

poses: wide shot of the bedroom doorway, she stands holding her phone showing the late hour, full body,
extreme close up of the phone screen and her ringed fingertip on it,
from a low angle, she looks up at the ceiling and breathes out, throat line visible,
medium shot from the side, she sits down on the bed edge without asking, hands flat on the mattress,
lines: わざと　じゃ　ないですよね
lines2: 連絡する　相手も　いませんし
……そこ、　軽く　言う　んだ

poses: wide shot of the dark bedroom, she lies on top of the covers facing away, full body, faint window light,
close up of her left hand resting near the edge of the blanket, ring catching the faint light,
from above, overhead of her on the bed with one arm over her eyes,
medium shot from the side, she has turned toward viewer, eyes open in the dark,
lines2: 手、　つないでても　いいですか

poses: wide shot of the kitchen at midnight lit only by the range hood lamp, she stands at the sink, full body,
close up of a glass of water in her ringed hand, condensation on the glass,
from a high angle behind her, the dim kitchen and her shoulders, back view,
medium shot from the side, she notices viewer in the doorway and does not move away,
lines: ……水　飲みに　来ただけ　です

poses: wide shot of the bedroom, she sits upright on the bed with her hands flat on her knees, full body, morning light,
close up of her face turned toward viewer, steady gaze, hair loose from the bun,
from above at a slight dutch angle, the bed and her sitting in the middle of it, ring on her knee,
medium shot from the side, viewer looks away and she watches him do it,
lines: 目、　そらさなくて　いいですよ
lines2: わたしは　もう　そらして　ません
……そっちの　ほうが　ずるい

poses: wide shot of the bedroom, she sits sideways on the bed with the closed report file beside her, full body,
close up of her left hand placing the spare key on top of the closed file, ring right next to it,
from a high angle, the bed with the file and the key on it, her legs crossed,
medium shot from a low angle, she leans toward viewer, hair down over one shoulder,
lines: 今日で、　契約は　最後です
beats.narration: このあと　めちゃくちゃ　S〇Xした
lines2: ここから先は、　報告書に　書きません
